name: daily-note
description: Morning and evening routines for an Obsidian vault. /daily-note:start-my-day builds today's daily note with a Summary paragraph, an Alert list and one heading per meeting. /daily-note:end-my-day completes it: missing meetings, transcript links with a short recap from the Gemini notes, project tags, text-corrector fixes, an End of day paragraph and a Review list of loose ends and stale CLAUDE.md files. meeting-recap does the recap for one meeting on request. Steps are small prompt files run in a fixed order. One script does every write to the note, with a backup first.
